items.title: US rocket fails after launch, payload of Amazon internet satellites destroyed
items.summary: BROWNSVILLE, Nov 15 () - A ‌Vulcan rocket ‌owned by United Launch ​Alliance, the joint venture of Boeing ‌and Lockheed ⁠Martin, failed on Sunday ⁠shortly after launch ​from Florida ​while ​carrying 40 ‌satellites for Amazon's Leo broadband internet unit. The failure doomed ‌the payload ​and ​marked ​the launch ‌company's first mission ​failure ​in its two-decade history.
